import subprocess, sys, time, os, signal
data = open('/app/work/oneshot.jsonl','rb').read()

                     stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)

out=[]

    time.sleep(1)
    rc = p.poll()
    if rc is not None:
        break
out_b, err_b = b'', b''

    os.kill(p.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
    res = ("STILL RUNNING after %ds" % (time.time()-t0))
else:
    out_b, err_b = p.communicate()
    res = ("exited rc=%s after %.1fs" % (p.poll(), time.time()-t0), out_b[:300], err_b[:3000])
open('/app/work/drv2.out','w').write(repr(res))
